observations: Black PlayStation 4 console, original 'fat' model with a split glossy and matte top surface.
The PlayStation logo is visible on the glossy top panel in photo 0.
Two DualShock 4 controllers are shown in photo 0: one black/grey and one red.
The rear of the console in photo 1 shows power, optical audio, HDMI, Ethernet, and AUX ports.
Watermarks 'GADGET WORLD' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are overlaid on both images.
The console appears to have some surface dust and minor scuffs on the glossy section.

claims.evidence: No photos show the console powered on or connected to a television screen.

claims.claim: comes with a pad extra pad

risks.risk: The console may have a faulty APU (Blue Light of Death) or HDMI port issues.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the PlayStation home screen and launching a game.

risks.risk: The internal hard drive capacity is unknown (500GB or 1TB).
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Storage' menu in the console settings.

risks.risk: The optical disc drive may be unable to read or eject discs.
risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted, recognized, and ejected.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive

risks.risk: The controllers may have analog stick drift or failing batteries.
risks.proof: A video of the controllers being used to navigate menus or a controller test application.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the main dashboard.
Photo of the 'System Information' or 'Storage' screen showing the HDD size.
Photo of the model number sticker (e.g., CUH-10xx, 11xx, or 12xx) located on the back or bottom.
Video demonstrating both controllers working without stick drift.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as an original model PlayStation 4. Due to the lack of proof of functionality, it is priced as a non-working unit for parts/repair with 500GB storage.
